03 / The important differences

What is not.

Compare the actual capability boundaries. Complete is the broadest first-year product programme, with advanced features introduced progressively after the core launch.

Why Complete? AED 20,000 above Advanced supports a launch-first product programme, monthly releases, broader roles, membership and enterprise foundations. The full 252-entry research backlog is not a fixed delivery promise. Each release has an agreed scope and acceptance check.

The commercial essentials

Engagement

Operating and provider costs
Separate from the development fee

Renewal requires a separate agreement defining maintenance, management, support and capacity. It is not automatic and does not include unlimited development.

To confirm before signing
Client legal entity · kickoff date · VAT/tax treatment · payment method · proposal validity · review periods · support/SLA · IP transfer · cancellation/termination · governing law and dispute process. Confidentiality and data-processing responsibilities also require agreement.
